import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data.split()[0]  # first token
    if not s:
        return
    run = 1
    result = 0
    previous = s[0]
    for ch in s[1:]:
        if ch == previous:
            run += 1
        else:
            if run % 2 == 0:
                result += 1
            previous = ch
            run = 1
    if run % 2 == 0:
        result += 1
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
